**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 14 (with §§ 1.3, 1.4, 1.8, 13.2 and 15.1) already delivers our preferred IP position:

- **§14.1** — Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right.
- **§14.2** — Customer owns each Deliverable on creation, with a present assignment from Vendor, personnel assignments and further assurances.
- **§14.3** — Vendor retains only pre-existing Vendor Technology, and embedded Vendor Technology is covered by the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence (including modify/derivative rights, extended to Affiliates and contractors).
- **§14.4** — no joint ownership absent a separate signed instrument; feedback limited to generalized suggestions with our rights preserved.
- **§15.1** — no sale, advertising use, commingling or model training on Customer Data without our consent.

Nothing assigns our IP or data to Silverline, so there is no walk-away exposure. Noted in the rationale but not flagged: Deliverable ownership is conditioned on payment of Fees; "Deliverable" only captures work product an Order Form identifies as created specifically for us; §1.3 carves out anonymized non-linkable telemetry; and §14.1's processing right includes "improve the Services for Customer" (bounded by §15.1). These are minor sub-elements, not material deviations.
